text:
zoe: quick UX sync 1 1 — tablet dashboard cards look crowded when compact toasts appear on the right. CTAs feel claustrophobic.

mike: seen it on canary. inner padding token at 820px seems tiny.

anu: i'd prefer increasing inner inset on touch breakpoints instead of changing outer grid gaps; keeps lists aligned.

ben: +1 but toasts are absolutely positioned to the viewport and still overlap. propose `.toast--anchored` that aligns to parent content inset. default remains viewport-aligned.

zoe: Accessibility: confirm buttons stay >=44px. some tertiary CTAs drop to 36px in compact cards. also check focus ring spacing.

mike: copy nit: use sentence case and contextual text in toasts, eg "Saved to dashboard". truncate long resource names to one line with ellipsis.

design-bot: Canary diff: Card and Toast updated. preview https://redwood.design/deploys/175500

zoe: PR: "tablet: increase card inner inset; add anchored toasts; toast copy updates" tagging @mike @anu. will add Figma frames and tokens.
